metadata.description: Unified and merged vocabulary JSON for小学英语必备词汇 and 2025初中考纲单词.
metadata.primary_source: 附录三：小学英语必备词汇(1).pdf
metadata.merge_policy: 初中考纲词表作为主词库；小学词表作为课程标签和来源引用合并。小学中的英式/变体/复数/称谓写法保存在 forms 与 source_refs 中。小学词条中文释义优先从初中考纲同义/对应词条回填。
metadata.learning_enrichment_policy: 规则型第一版增强：补充分类、推断词性、双学习档案难度、拼写提示、游戏标签、复习策略、词源等级入口。推断字段均带 confidence/source，后续可人工校正。

schema.headword: canonical word used by this JSON record
schema.display_word: word displayed to learners; may include canonical spelling only
schema.entry_type: word | phrase | abbreviation_or_title | word_with_variant | alternatives | irregular_plural | hyphenated
schema.meaning_cn: Chinese meaning used by learner UI

forms.source_display_forms: raw source display forms preserved from files

curriculum.source_levels: primary | junior tags, plus relationship fields below
curriculum.primary: true if present in小学词表 as headword or listed form
curriculum.primary_presence: none | headword | alternative | alias | plural_form | american_form | verb_form
curriculum.junior: true if present in初中考纲词表 as an explicit row

schema.metrics: letter/token statistics for scheduling and difficulty
